heroHeadline: Israel Seizes Ali al-Taher Ridge; Nabatieh Escalation Kills 27, Wounds 69 in Three Days
heroSubtitle: Israel announced 'operational control' of the strategic Ali al-Taher ridge on Sep 5 and widened strikes across the south, killing 27 and wounding 69 over three days — including 11 dead when a residential building in Kfar Reman was levelled on Sep 7. The UN Secretary-General demanded an Israeli withdrawal as UNIFIL logged the highest projectile and airspace-violation counts since June. President Aoun, Speaker Berri and PM Salam brokered de-escalation, and the Lebanese Army reinforced its Nabatieh deployment, though officials say the mission excludes Hezbollah disarmament. Relative calm had returned by Sep 9.
